title: Beach Please - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
Why Guests Love Staying at Beach Please:

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties 🏖️ Complex is right on the gulf (a couple mins and your feet are in the sand!) ⛱️ Seasonal beach chair service included (2 chairs + umbrella | March 1–Oct 31) 🚲 2 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes included with option to rent child carrier across the street (save $50/day) 🌅 PRIVATE beach for only 24 units 🌤️ Great view on the second floor in low-density condo building 🚶‍♀️ 1.3 Miles to Seaside 🛏️ Sleeps up to 4 (King bed and hall bunk beds) ☕ Keurig & drip coffee maker 🏊‍♀️ Community Pool 🧺 Washer/Dryer in unit 🔥 Community Grill 🍽️ Walking distance to restaurants & shopping in Seagrove and Seaside 📺 Smart TVs & cable in both living room and bedroom 🌐 High-speed wireless internet

Relax and unwind in this cozy Seagrove condo. Boasting Gulf views and direct beach access, this one-bedroom getaway comes fully equipped with all the comforts of home. The full kitchen comes ready for home cooking with a full suite of major appliances, including a dishwasher for easy cleanup. The private balcony is perfect for sipping a morning cup of coffee or a sunset cocktail. The spacious primary bedroom includes a smart TV for added entertainment options. A built-in hallway bunk nook is great for kids to have their own space.

WHAT'S NEARBY This property is part of the Beachside Condos, a Gulf-front complex in Seagrove Beach with a private boardwalk that leads to the beach. You'll be across the street from several shops, eateries, and recreational outfitters that rent bikes and kayaks.

THINGS TO KNOW Parking notes: 1 spot per unit. No assigned spot, can park in any spot.

Golf cart rentals are allowed. You can rent a gas powered golf cart and utilize your parking space OR rent a battery powered golf cart rental across the street at Butterfly Bike and Kayak and park/charge there.

This rental is located on floor 2. No elevator onsite.

Sorry, HOA does not allow pets.

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
Sleeping Arrangements: Common Spaces - 1 Bunk Bed, 1 Sleeper Sofa
